verdict.rationale: Galileo is an observability platform with SDKs, so whether its own SDK or console tracks usage, and whether users can opt out, is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry opt-out, a usage-tracking disable flag, or a privacy setting. The trace and span capture material (e.g., logging overview, OTel tracing) describes the product's core function of collecting customer application data, not opting out of the vendor's own telemetry, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
